title: MemPrism: Task-Conditioned Relational Memory Views for Long-Horizon Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.06745v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Long-horizon agents performing multi-step Web tasks must reuse earlier page observations and interactions to support subsequent actions. However, preserving relevant history does not ensure that it exposes the relations needed for the current decision. We call this gap representation mismatch. To this end, we propose MemPrism, a task-conditioned relational memory framework that separates persistent experience storage from decision-time working memory. MemPrism records interactions as the event stream and dynamically constructs relational views according to the current task context. A lightweight view policy selects the relation structure, evidence range, outcome condition, and granularity, while a deterministic composer and renderer transform historical facts into a temporary optical working-memory view for a frozen task policy. translated_title: MemPrism：面向长时程智能体的任务条件化关系记忆视图
translated_abstract: 执行多步网络任务的长时程智能体必须复用先前的页面观察和交互记录来支持后续动作。然而，保留相关历史并不保证这些历史能够暴露当前决策所需的关系，我们将这一差距称为“表征失配”。为此，我们提出了MemPrism，一个任务条件化的关系记忆框架，它将持久经验存储与决策时工作记忆相分离。MemPrism将交互记录为事件流，并根据当前任务上下文动态构建关系视图。一个轻量级的视图策略负责选择关系结构、证据范围、结果条件和粒度，而确定性的组合器与渲染器则将历史事实转化为临时的光学工作记忆视图，供冻结的任务策略使用。在长时程具身智能体和网络智能体基准上的实验表明，MemPrism持续提升了……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出MemPrism框架，通过任务条件化的关系记忆视图将持久经验存储与决策时工作记忆分离，动态构建关系视图以解决长时程智能体中的表征失配问题，并在具身智能和网络智能体基准上取得持续提升。
en_tdlr: MemPrism is a task-conditioned relational memory framework that separates persistent experience storage from decision-time working memory, dynamically constructing relational views to address representation mismatch in long-horizon agents, achieving consistent improvements on embodied and web-agent benchmarks.
